detail: 無 `ops-edit user-delete` 原語 → reshape 用的 throwaway scratch 帳號(及一般 demo 帳號)會殘留在 users.json(`_` 前綴者 `is_real_user=False` 自動隱藏於 fleet-overview,但實體條目仍在),只能靠手寫 scoped script 清(本 session 即如此)。候選:`ops-edit user-delete <uid>`(移 user dir + users.json 條目 + email/subscription index scrub,dry-run 預設、寫前自動備份)。**2026-08-05 取證**:`ops_edit.py --help` 列 20 個子指令(user-create/card-add/card-update/card-set-review/card-delete/card-import/notebook-create/user-config-set/link-add/link-delete/seed/clone-demo/world-snapshot/world-restore/list-backups/restore/notebook-update/notebook-delete/card-move/link-list/link-update),**無 `user-delete`**。
plan:
1) backend/src/kg/ops_edit_user_commands.py — insert def cmd_user_delete(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int right after cmd_user_create ends at :100 and before cmd_user_config_set at :102. Body mirrors cmd_user_create: uid = args.uid; assert_safe_uid(uid); dd = data_dir(); uf = users_file(dd); users = load_users_from(uf, _passthrough_normalize) if uf.exists() else {}; plan = {uid, removes_dir: str(user_dir_for(dd, uid)), had_record: isinstance(users.get(uid), dict), email_index_keys: [k for k, v in (users.get(_email_index) or {}).items() if v == uid], subscription_index_keys: [k for k, v in (users.get(_subscription_index) or {}).items() if v == uid]}; ctx = EditContext(data_dir=dd, uid=uid, commit=args.commit, json_mode=args.json) — do NOT pass require_user=False: the default True at ops_edit_shared.py:341 is what makes a missing uid raise EditError instead of silently succeeding. apply_fn: define mutate(users) that does users.pop(uid, None) then, for each of the two index buckets _email_index and _subscription_index, drops every key whose value == uid; call _mutate_users(dd, mutate) (ops_edit_support.py:326 — it holds the same FileLock the app uses) and then shutil.rmtree(user_dir_for(dd, uid)). verify_fn: re-read users from uf and return {ok: uid not in users and not user_dir_for(dd, uid).exists() and no remaining index value equals uid}. return ctx.run(action="user-delete", plan=plan, apply_fn=apply_fn, verify_fn=verify_fn). Every name used (shutil, _mutate_users, user_dir_for, users_file, load_users_from, _passthrough_normalize, assert_safe_uid, EditContext, data_dir) is already imported at :1-36 — add no imports. _subscription_index is the bucket written by backend/src/kg/billing/index.py:14 and read by resolve_user_id_from_subscription_index at :25; leaving it behind makes an App Store transaction id resolve to a uid that no longer exists.
2) Reversibility is inherited, do not reimplement it: EditContext.run backs up BEFORE apply (ops_edit_shared.py:379-382), backup_user_dir embeds the users.json record plus the uid-scoped email index (schema kg.ops_user_backup.v2, ops_edit_shared.py:192-205), and _ops_backups/ sits outside users/<uid>/ so it survives the rmtree; cmd_restore (:342-393) already runs require_user=False and recreates dir+record, so ops-edit restore <uid> undoes the delete. ONE asymmetry must be written into the new docstring and surfaced in the emitted plan payload: _restore_user_record_snapshot (ops_edit_support.py:336-345) restores record + email index only, never _subscription_index, so a delete-then-restore loses the transaction-id mapping.
3) backend/src/kg/ops_edit_commands.py — add cmd_user_delete to the .ops_edit_user_commands import at :15 and to __all__ at :16-40.
4) backend/src/kg/ops_edit_parser.py — add cmd_user_delete to the ops_edit_commands import block at :8-30, and register the subparser directly after the user-create block at :47-50: p = sub.add_parser("user-delete", parents=[jp, cp], help="刪除用戶(移除 user dir + users.json record + email/subscription index;寫前自動備份,可 restore)"); p.add_argument("uid"); p.set_defaults(func=cmd_user_delete).
5) backend/tests/test_ops_edit_user_commands_unit.py — add class TestUserDelete (name matters: acceptance selects it with -k UserDelete) after TestUserCreate (:44-90), reusing _make_args and monkeypatch.setenv(KG_DATA_DIR, str(tmp_path)). Five tests: (a) dry run on an existing user returns 0, prints dry-run, and leaves the dir in place; (b) --commit removes the user dir AND the users.json record AND the _email_index entry; (c) a hand-seeded _subscription_index entry pointing at the uid is scrubbed while another users entry is untouched; (d) deleting an absent uid raises EditError; (e) round trip — user-create --commit, card or notebook write, user-delete --commit, then cmd_restore(--commit) puts user_dir and the users.json record back.
6) Same-PR agent-facing sync (CLAUDE.md scope rule, or the next agent will not know the command exists): .claude/skills/devops/SKILL.md — add a user-delete line to the ops-edit subcommand block right after :114; docs/reference/tech_index.md:184 — name user-delete in the 寫入面 paragraph beside user-create and state the restore asymmetry from step 2.
7) Deliberately out of scope: no extra real-account guard beyond the existing dry-run default. user-create has none, and the automatic pre-write backup plus restore is the safety net; adding a bespoke --force here would be an unreviewed policy change.
resolution: —(2026-08-05 驗證 CONFIRMED-OPEN;落點新 `cmd_user_delete`+parser,寫前備份沿用既有 world-snapshot,成本 M,測試 `backend/tests/test_ops_edit_user_commands_unit.py`。**不併入 0024/0026**:無共用程式碼,是 reshape 流程的收尾清理,可獨立出貨;若 0024 的 `--replace` 落地,本條的觸發源(throwaway scratch)會消失、降為一般 demo 清理需求)
